svg.title: WarpSum round by round
svg.text: WarpSum: 32 lanes add up their values in 5 rounds of __shfl_xor_sync
value of lane t: x[t]² + x[t+128]² + … + x[t+1408]², x = the embedding of " is"
Each lane adds the value of lane ^ offset to its own. Teal: what lane 0's sum is built from; after 5 rounds
it holds all 32 starting values, and so does every other lane: 0.1553 everywhere.
offset = 16, 8, 4, 2, 1; every lane reads value from lane ^ offset (a register of that lane) and adds it
